say:1:1331115101:1.text: Well, even someone as tough as me has caught a cold three times this winter. This is just too much for the princess!
say:1:1331115101:1.source_cn: 这还用问吗？连我这种皮糙肉厚的人一个冬天能感冒三次，公...

say:2:1331115102:1.text: I'd never have come to this godforsaken place if Haldor hadn't asked for my help with his new inventions.
say:2:1331115102:1.source_cn: 要不是老约恩那家伙说新发明需要我帮忙，我才不来雪松镇。

say:3:1331115103:1.text: I'll head straight to somewhere warmer as soon as I finish this gig!
say:3:1331115103:1.source_cn: 等忙完这份活计，我就立刻搬走，搬到一个暖和的地方去！
